messages:
jin-customer: Hi team — trying to apply promo FREE30 on a new signup from SG, billing currency SGD, but the checkout rejects it. Error says promo not eligible. We need to grant free-trial credits ASAP, customer is blocked.
jamie-support: thanks @jin-customer — can you paste the exact API response or screenshot of checkout? which plan and amount?
jin-customer: It was the Starter monthly plan, listed price SGD 19.00. Checkout shows tax: GST 2.28 and total SGD 21.28. I clicked 'Apply promo' and saw: 'Promo cannot be applied to orders where tax is included or regional tax rules prevent discounts'. Screenshot attached (not included here). thread id #1782349000
jamie-support: copying in @sarah-billing to confirm tax/promo rules for SG.
sarah-billing: looking. Quick summary: in SG digital services incur 8% GST (note: numbers for example). Our promo engine currently expects promos to be applied to pre-tax subtotal. If the merchant/storefront signals "tax_inclusive": true, our checkout computes tax differently and we have a guard that prevents promo application in some flows to avoid negative/zero rounding edge-cases.
jamie-support: @jin-customer can you share the checkout payload (if from API) or confirm if the merchant uses tax_inclusive pricing in their product catalog?
jin-customer: This is via API call from their web checkout. Here's the apply call they sent:

```
POST /v1/promos/apply
{
  "promo_code": "FREE30",
  "customer_id": "cust_4321",
  "currency": "SGD",
  "items": [{ "sku": "starter-monthly", "unit_price": 1900, "quantity": 1, "tax_inclusive": true }]
}
```

Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
{
  "error": "promo_ineligible_tax_policy",
  "message": "Promo cannot be applied to orders where tax is included or GST is charged in this region. See billing docs. code: PROMO_TAX_POLICY"
}
```

jamie-support: thanks — that matches what I'm seeing. @leo-eng can you confirm whether the promo behaviour is intentional for SG or if this is a bug? This customer expects free-trial credit to reduce their charge to 0.
leo-eng: quick take — the promo engine has a protection: if line items are tax_inclusive && region_has_vat_gst && promo_applies_to_pre_tax_total only, we currently return ineligible because we can't reliably determine pre-tax subtotal without storefront cooperation. This avoids refunds/ledger inconsistencies. Implementation lives in promos/service/apply.py around the tax eligibility check.

Snippet:
```
# promos/service/apply.py
if item.tax_inclusive and region.has_vat and not payload.pre_tax_amount:
    raise PromoError("promo_ineligible_tax_policy")
```

That guard was added after a few chargeback incidents where discounts created sub-cent negative taxes.
sarah-billing: also note rounding in SGD: we round tax to 2 decimals, but when a 100% discount is applied after tax-inclusive flow, rounding can produce negative totals. Policy currently blocks auto-applying free credits for tax_inclusive SKUs unless merchant provides pre_tax_amount or flags that they want promo_applied_pre_tax.
jamie-support: short-term option for this customer: we can manually grant account credit equivalent to promo value so they can complete sign-up. Long-term: engineering should add an explicit path to accept promo application by treating promo as pre-tax discount when merchant indicates they support it.
leo-eng: agree. Proposed fixes:
- Accept a new optional flag in /promos/apply: "force_pre_tax_apply": true (requires merchant attestation in request). When set, we compute pre-tax subtotal by backing out tax using region tax rate and apply promo there. Add strict validations and audit log.
- Or require storefront to send "pre_tax_amount" per line item; this is more accurate and safer.

I'll draft a PR for the second option (require pre_tax_amount) and a temporary admin tool to grant credits.
jamie-support: can we do a manual credit now? how much to give for FREE30 on SGD 19 plan?
sarah-billing: FREE30 is 1 month free; that's SGD 19.00. Since GST would have been charged, final charge should be 0. We'll issue account credit of SGD 21.28 to fully cover tax+plan for the first invoice. I'll create a billing adjustment and note promo id FREE30_manual_grant.
promo-bot: [automated note] Created billing adjustment ADJ-9921 for cust_4321, amount: SGD 21.28, issued by sarah-billing.
jin-customer: thanks team — customer confirmed they can finish signup after credit applied.
jamie-support: follow-ups: @leo-eng please open a ticket for the promo engine change and label as P1 for correctness in taxed regions. @sarah-billing please document manual-grant procedure in ops runbook.
leo-eng: will do. ETA for PR: 5 working days to require pre_tax_amount and update docs, plus a hotfix admin checkbox to allow trusted merchants to use force_pre_tax_apply with additional logging in 2 days.
sarah-billing: ops runbook note added: "When promo fails with PROMO_TAX_POLICY for tax_inclusive SKUs, offer manual credit and escalate to engineering. Use ADJ- prefix and include region and tax breakdown."
jamie-support: thanks everyone — marking resolved for this thread, customer unblocked. :white_check_mark:
